source_caption:
🎬 Good Burger (1997)

Good Burger follows Dexter Reed, a teenager who takes a summer job at a small fast-food restaurant after getting into trouble and needing money to pay for damages. There, he meets Ed, a lovable but hilariously clueless employee whose unusual personality makes every workday unpredictable. When a massive new burger restaurant opens across the street and threatens to put Good Burger out of business, Dexter and Ed must find a way to save their workplace. With the help of Ed’s secret sauce, the unlikely duo faces outrageous challenges, ridiculous schemes, and a powerful competitor determined to destroy their business. Combining hilarious comedy, unforgettable characters, and classic Nickelodeon humor, the film explores friendship, teamwork, loyalty, and the importance of believing in yourself.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family

⭐ IMDb: 5.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 35m • PG

🎥 Director: Brian Robbins

🏆 Recognition: Starring Kenan Thompson and Kel Mitchell, the film became a beloved Nickelodeon cult classic, famous for Ed’s iconic catchphrase, “Welcome to Good Burger, home of the Good Burger, can I take your order?” Its popularity eventually led to the sequel Good Burger 2 (2023).

source_details.synopsis: Good Burger is a 1997 American teen comedy film starring Kenan Thompson and Kel Mitchell. It was directed by Brian Robbins, and written by Dan Schneider with Kevin Kopelow and Heath Seifert. The film is a spin-off of the "Good Burger" comedy sketch from the Nickelodeon variety series All That, with Mitchell reprising his role as Ed. The story follows Dexter Reed, a high school student who, to pay off the damages he made to his teacher's car, takes a summer job at the titular fast-food restaurant, where he and Ed, his dimwitted co-worker, stumble upon an evil plot by a rival fast-food restaurant. The film was produced by Nickelodeon Movies and Tollin/Robbins Productions. It premiered on July
